scripts.build: npm run build:analytics && npm run build:components && npm run build:install
scripts.build:components: mkdir -p components/dist/css components/dist/js && cleancss -o components/dist/css/components.css components/src/css/components.css && terser components/src/js/components.js -o components/dist/js/components.js -c -m
scripts.build:install: mkdir -p install/dist/css install/dist/js && cleancss -o install/dist/css/install-experience.css install/src/css/install-experience.css && esbuild install/src/js/install-experience.js --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --minify --outfile=install/dist/js/install-experience.js
